_comment: Sound design cue sheet for kopare-android-teaser-1080x1920.mp4. 'at' is seconds into the video. Each cue is generated once with ElevenLabs text-to-sound-effects and may be placed at several 'at' times.

cues.name: bed
cues.prompt: subtle low cinematic ambient drone bed, warm and calm, very quiet, slowly evolving, no melody

cues.name: riser
cues.prompt: soft ethereal shimmer riser, particles of light gathering, rising tension, magical, builds to a point

cues.name: ignite
cues.prompt: deep cinematic impact boom with a bright spark burst and airy whoosh tail, powerful but clean

cues.name: expand
cues.prompt: smooth rounded whoosh swell with a soft synthetic pop, UI shape expanding

cues.name: bounce
cues.prompt: playful soft rubber ball bouncing and settling, two quick bounces, cute and light

cues.name: heartpop
cues.prompt: cute bubbly pop with a small sparkle chime, delightful app notification

cues.name: heartbeat
cues.prompt: warm soft heartbeat, two gentle thumps, intimate and close, no music

cues.name: letters
cues.prompt: six rapid gentle UI ticks in quick succession, soft wooden taps, staggered, premium app sound

cues.name: sheen
cues.prompt: bright glistening shimmer sweep across glass, short sparkle, elegant

cues.name: slam
cues.prompt: punchy cinematic text hit, short tight bass thump with a quick air whoosh, trailer style, dry

cues.name: calm
cues.prompt: soft warm synth pad swell, gentle, hopeful and calm, slow bloom then settles

cues.name: wipe
cues.prompt: fast smooth cloth swish transition whoosh, left to right, clean

cues.name: confetti
cues.prompt: cheerful party popper confetti burst followed by a bright celebratory chime, happy app launch

cues.name: typing
cues.prompt: seven rapid staccato soft pops in quick succession, letters landing, playful

cues.name: sting
cues.prompt: gentle warm logo sting, soft bell chord that resolves, premium calm app brand sound, short
